title: Bugs happen: The easy way to compare solo PQ to ECC+PQ
summary: Daniel J. Bernstein's blog post analyzing implementation bugs in post-quantum cryptography, specifically comparing pure post-quantum (solo PQ) implementations versus hybrid approaches combining elliptic curve cryptography with post-quantum (ECC+PQ) to understand security tradeoffs in different PQC deployment strategies.
problem_solved: Understanding and comparing the frequency and severity of implementation bugs between solo PQ and hybrid ECC+PQ cryptographic implementations
why_valuable: Provides empirical analysis to help organizations make informed decisions about PQC migration strategies, balancing security, compatibility, and implementation complexity
